version.value: Copland’s 1957 orchestral version of Piano Variations (1930)
version.note: The sleeve and selected track identify Orchestral Variations, 1957. This is not Variations on a Shaker Melody. The performing edition and parts are unknown.

label.note: Stereo vinyl LP, coupled with Bloch’s Three Jewish Poems and Copland’s Fanfare.

catalogue.note: The specific transferred US carrier is catalogued as a 1961 release.

recording.value: Territorial EU phonogram public-domain basis: commercial publication in 1961, before 1963
recording.note: Under the project’s eu-published-before-1963 rule, the carrier’s former 50-year phonogram term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is not a US-government recording, a Creative Commons licence, US public-domain status or worldwide clearance. Composition rights remain separate.
